note: Pins are the SHAs the reference corpus was last validated against. Advance only via tools/sync-external.mjs --advance.

vta-browser-plugin.why: #275: a QR button beside every DID the extension draws (a bare DID, "Scan with Keyring"), for the first real phone scan of an upstream DID QR; carries #272 (the consent-window race, VTI-40), superseding our local fix

verifiable-trust-infrastructure.why: Tag VTI-Eucalyptus (vta-service 0.56.0, vta-sdk 0.64.2), the release milestone after Dogwood. vta-sdk here accepts only the DTG v1 shapes (vetted/1 StatementCredential, role VAC); card-verify moved to them in the same pull request.

verifiable-trust-infrastructure-v047.why: A second, separate clone of VTI at tag vta-service-v0.47.0 (DTG Credentials v1, #1859): card-verify-v047 is built from it so bifold's vti-conformance job can have vta-sdk 0.58 judge the vetted/1 statement Keyring writes behind its off-by-default flag (228). The main pin above, its clone and the frozen lab do not move with it.

affinidi-tdk-rs.why: Tag VTI-Eucalyptus: affinidi-messaging-sdk 0.33.2, the version openvtc 0.5.0 builds with.

openvtc.why: Tag VTI-Eucalyptus: openvtc 0.5.0 (#481; no v0.5.0 git tag), vta-sdk 0.63.3, messaging-sdk 0.33.2. Carries the VTI-67 may_claim fix (#456) that v0.4.0 lacked.

dtgwg-trust-tasks-tf.why: Tag trust-tasks-v0.27.7, the trust-tasks-rs version VTI vta-service-v0.55.0 builds with. Publishes the hidden-vetting task specs (vtc/vetting/hidden/{publish,show,withdraw}/0.1, vtc/vetting/pcs-challenge/0.1), vtc/vetting/vetters/event-mode/0.1, and the hidden path in vetting/attestation/0.1, so they can be cited and used as fixtures at a pin.

dtgwg-cred-spec.why: Seeded for the locality plan: the VWC schema half (witnessContext, taskContext, digest) could not be verified locally. HEAD at #14 — digest REQUIRED; #18 (taskDigestMultibase on the credential) still open.

predicate-credential-system.why: The source of the published crate predicate-credential-system 0.1.0 (tag predicate-credential-system-v0.1.0), so citations in the zero-knowledge work name a pinned commit. Main is 3 commits ahead with a dependency bump only (affinidi-did-resolver-cache-sdk 0.8.40), not yet released.

verifiable-trust-infrastructure-signin.why: A separate clone of VTI main for the trigger-link sign-in test bed only (keyring-wallet #354 sign-in half; dtgwg-vti-spec #58). Carries #1997 (auth/oob grants signed for assertionMethod, UV-key enrolment) and #2007 (the VTC sign-in service and member portal), which no release has yet. Upstream says never track VTI main: this pin feeds the test bed alone. The release pin above, its clone, the lab baseline and the gate do not move with it. Replace with a release tag once one carries both.

vta-browser-plugin-signin.why: A separate clone of the browser plugin with the reference trigger-link reader and auth/oob approver (#303), and its follow-ups #304 and #305 (register the install as a device before sign-in). Read as the reference for Keyring's sign-in; the main plugin pin above does not move.

dtgwg-trust-tasks-tf-signin.why: Tag trust-tasks-v0.27.8, the first release carrying the auth/oob task specs (#738: claim, identify, prove, grant, respond, request, redeem, cancel). Cited by the sign-in rungs (tsp-reference ref-21+). Kept separate from the v0.27.7 pin above, which matches the VTI release the lab runs.

affinidi-tdk-rs-signin.why: A separate clone of tdk main for the sign-in test bed's own TSP mediator (port 7057, Redis db 3): the lab mediator is a did:peer with no TSPTransport, so a VTA on it may not advertise #tsp, and Keyring talks TSP to its agents. Main is 5 commits past VTI-Eucalyptus, including #928 (mediator secrets in one backend secret, breaking) and #930; nothing in them changes TSP. VTI main 03a3562f builds with messaging-sdk 0.33.2, the same as the release pin. The release pin above, the lab mediator and the gate do not move.

@openvtc/vti-tsp-js.tripwire: our noble HPKE is the shipped wire layer; any bump = crypto or CESR change — audit before adopting

@openvtc/pnm-core.tripwire: channel chain + consent surface; minor bump = wallet-facing API moved

@openvtc/trust-tasks.tripwire: the Cypress lock; any bump past 0.9.x = post-Cypress framework movement
